fields.description: Canonical table name the raw source maps to.
Column whose value drives Hive partitioning (or use fields[].partitions).

Tabular array of {name,selector,type[,format,description,unit,classification]}. format is a strptime pattern (e.g. %B %d,%Y) for a DATE/TIMESTAMP field and replaces the pipeline's date/timestamp format list for it; epoch / epoch_ms read a TIMESTAMP from a count of seconds / milliseconds since 1970 (UTC; 0 = none).
Logical name of the raw source.

notes: `raw.fields[]` items are `{name, selector, type}` plus optional `format`, `description`, `unit` and `classification` (one the Space knows).
The engine parses more than the spec names (Identifiers.validateSchema at run time); a shipped schema may also carry `partitions[]`. The component's id is its `schema_file: schema/<id>` reference.
